LESSON: PRANAYAM

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Yoga
Topic 5.1: Pranayam

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Pranayam
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: What is “Pranayama”?

1. perform simple breathing information about breathing exercises exercises to become from parents, guardians and priests. spiritually and physically fit 
